name: File Explorer Plugin
description: Recursive file tree browser rendered as inline DOM elements. Directories sorted first, then files alphabetically. Expand/collapse with arrow indicators (▸/▾). File coloring by extension (accent for TS/JS, accent2 for CSS, amber for JSON/YAML, green for MD). Right-click context menus: for files — Copy, Paste, Rename, Delete, plus 'Open to Markdown' for .md files; for directories — New File, New Folder, Copy, Paste, Rename, Delete; for empty area — New File, New Folder, Paste. Paste resolves naming conflicts with _copy_N suffix. Inline input for file/folder creation (Enter commits, Escape cancels, blur also commits). Delete confirmation via ConfirmModal. External file change watching with 500ms debounced reload. SelectFile auto-expands parent directories to reveal the file path.

dependencies.usage: Right-click context menu on files and directories
